question: The 28th National Conference on e-Governance (NCeG) was held in _______________ during June 2025.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Visakhapatnam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 28th National Conference on e-Governance (NCeG)** was held in **Visakhapatnam**, Andhra Pradesh, in **June 2025**.
 
• The conference was jointly organized by the **Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)**, the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)**, and the **Government of Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• **Theme:** The theme of the conference was centered on **“e-Governance: A Decade of Digital Transformation”**, focusing on leveraging technology for enhancing governance and citizen-centric service delivery.
 
• The conference provided a platform for policymakers, industry leaders, and IT experts to discuss **innovative practices** in e-Governance, emerging technologies, and their applications in public service delivery.
 
• Several **best practices** in e-Governance initiatives from different states were showcased during the event, emphasizing digital inclusion and innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About the National Conference on e-Governance (NCeG):**

 
 
• The National Conference on e-Governance is an annual event aimed at promoting excellence in e-Governance initiatives across India.
 
• The conference is jointly organized by the **Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)** and the **Ministry of Electronics and IT (MeitY)**.
 
• It serves as a platform to exchange knowledge, showcase best practices, and discuss emerging trends in e-Governance.
 
 
 
• **e-Governance in India:**
 
 
• e-Governance involves the use of **Information and Communication Technology (ICT)** to deliver government services efficiently and transparently to citizens.
 
• Major e-Governance initiatives in India include **DigiLocker**, **UMANG App**, **e-Way Bill**, and **GeM (Government e-Marketplace)**.
 
• It aims to promote **transparency**, **accountability**, and **citizen empowerment**.
 
 
 
• **Visakhapatnam:**
 
 
• Visakhapatnam, also known as **Vizag**, is a major port city in Andhra Pradesh, renowned for its natural harbor and industrial significance.
 
• It is a hub for **technology-driven initiatives** and has been actively participating in **digital transformation** projects.
 
• The city is also famous for hosting events of national and international importance, including conferences on IT and governance.
 
 
 
• **Digital Transformation in Governance:**
 
 
• Digital transformation in governance encompasses the adoption of modern technologies like **AI**, **blockchain**, **cloud computing**, and **data analytics** to improve public administration and service delivery.
 
• Initiatives like **Aadhaar**, **Digital India**, and **Smart Cities Mission** are examples of India's progress in digital governance.
